knowledge_documents.title: Return Policy
knowledge_documents.content: Our return policy allows customers to return items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in original condition with tags attached. To initiate a return, customers should visit their order history and select 'Start Return' next to the relevant item. A prepaid return label will be emailed within 24 hours. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after receiving the returned item.

knowledge_documents.title: Shipping Guide
knowledge_documents.content: We offer three shipping options: Standard (5-7 business days, free over $50), Express (2-3 business days, $9.99), and Overnight (next business day, $24.99). All orders placed before 2 PM EST ship same day. International shipping is available to 45 countries with delivery times of 7-14 business days. Tracking information is emailed once the order ships.

knowledge_documents.title: Warranty Information
knowledge_documents.content: All electronics carry a 2-year manufacturer warranty. Apparel and accessories have a 6-month warranty against defects. Warranty claims can be submitted through the support portal or by contacting support@store.example.com. Warranty coverage does not include damage from misuse, accidents, or normal wear and tear.

knowledge_documents.title: Product Catalog Overview
knowledge_documents.content: Our product line includes: Premium Headphones ($149-$399), Wireless Speakers ($79-$249), Smart Home Devices ($49-$199), and Accessories ($19-$89). Our best sellers are the WNC-001 Noise-Canceling Headphones and the PBS-700 Bluetooth Speaker. Enterprise volume discounts are available for orders of 10+ units.

knowledge_documents.title: Pricing Plans
knowledge_documents.content: Starter Plan: $29/month — 1 bot, 1,000 conversations/month, email support. Professional Plan: $99/month — 5 bots, 10,000 conversations/month, priority support, analytics dashboard. Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing — unlimited bots, unlimited conversations, dedicated account manager, SSO, custom integrations.
